onboarding.title: Print business cheques on preprinted stock
onboarding.subtitle: Create exact PDFs, print locally and keep a private cheque register. No account or bank connection is required.
onboarding.preprinted.title: Preprinted cheque stock is required
onboarding.preprinted.body: Your stock must already contain the bank identity and MICR routing and account line. This app adds the date, payee, amounts, memo and optional cheque number.
onboarding.noLetterhead: Ordinary company letterhead is not cheque stock.
onboarding.nextNumber: Next number printed on your physical stock
home.newChequeHelp: Create a cheque, review the exact PDF, then save or print it.
home.pendingOutcome: A print result still needs your confirmation.
cheque.review.title: Review every detail before using cheque stock
cheque.review.body: The PDF is the authoritative print output. Confirm the number, date, payee, amount, memo, stock position and printer.
cheque.fitError: This text does not fit safely on the selected stock. Shorten the highlighted field.
output.sampleHelp: Watermarked samples and calibration sheets are always free.
print.outcome.title: What happened to the physical cheque?
print.outcome.correctHelp: Record the cheque as printed and add it to the register.
print.outcome.problemHelp: Mark this number as spoiled. A replacement will use the next physical number.
print.outcome.unknown: If paper may have been marked, choose the problem option and secure or destroy the original.
print.spoiled: Cheque {number} is recorded as spoiled. Do not use the physical cheque.
print.notSent: Nothing was printed. The cheque is ready to try again.
register.empty: Printed cheques will appear here automatically.
register.notBalance: These are cheque totals, not a bank balance.
restore.confirmNumbers: Before printing again, confirm the next number on each account's physical stock.
restore.freeConservative: A restored backup cannot prove how many free cheques were printed afterward. Free printing is therefore unavailable until Lifetime Unlock is restored or purchased.
purchase.summary: Print unlimited real cheques with a one-time purchase. No subscription and no ads.
purchase.freeDisclosure: The first 3 real cheques are free. Samples and calibration sheets do not count.
purchase.status.verificationRequired: Connect to Microsoft Store to verify Lifetime Unlock before starting another real cheque.
purchase.freeLimitReached: You have used the 3 free real cheques. Buy Lifetime Unlock to print more.
purchase.priceRequired: Connect once so Microsoft Store can show the current price before a free real cheque is used.
privacy.localOnly: Cheque records stay encrypted on this device unless you export, print or back them up.
terms.preprinted: For compatible preprinted business cheque stock only. The app does not print MICR bank information.
state.startup.warning.body: The previous session did not close normally. Review the recovered local data before printing.
state.home.idle.body: Review the account, next physical number and pending print outcomes before creating a cheque.
state.home.warning.body: A pending print outcome or physical-number confirmation must be resolved before another real cheque.
state.home.error.body: The summary could not be loaded. Reopen the local file before creating or printing a cheque.
state.home.success.body: The account and printer profile are ready for the next cheque.
state.account.idle.body: Choose an account or add the bank jurisdiction, currency and next physical cheque number.
state.account.empty.body: No account profile exists. Add one without entering routing or online-banking credentials.
state.account.warning.body: The next physical cheque number has not been confirmed since restore. Compare it with the stock in hand.
state.printer.idle.body: Choose the Windows printer used for this stock, or select Microsoft Print to PDF for testing.
state.calibration.empty.body: No calibration exists for this printer and stock. Print a ruler sheet before using real stock.
state.payee.empty.body: No payees are saved. Add the first payee to create a cheque.
state.payee.success.body: The payee was saved locally for future cheques.
state.cheque.idle.body: Enter the payee, date, amount and optional memo for the next physical number.
state.cheque.loading.body: Validating the draft against the selected stock and embedded font.
state.cheque.empty.body: No cheques match the current view. Create a new cheque or clear the filters.
state.cheque.warning.body: One or more details need review before this cheque can become Ready.
state.cheque.error.body: The cheque cannot be queued. Correct the highlighted field or confirm the physical number.
state.cheque.success.body: The cheque passed fit and stock validation and is ready for exact output.
state.pdf.empty.body: No ready PDF exists. Review and queue a cheque or create a free sample first.
state.pdf.warning.body: A live PDF can produce a negotiable cheque. Store it securely and verify the destination folder.
state.print.idle.body: Load the matching stock, confirm its next position and print at 100% / Actual size.
state.print.empty.body: No cheque is ready to print. Create or select a Ready cheque first.
state.register.idle.body: Search or filter cheques by account, number, date, payee, amount or status.
state.register.loading.body: Loading the encrypted local cheque register.
state.register.empty.body: No cheque records match these filters. Clear the filters or print the first cheque.
state.register.warning.body: Register totals describe cheques only and must not be treated as a bank balance.
state.restore.warning.body: After restore, confirm every next physical cheque number. Free usage is conservatively exhausted.
state.restore.success.body: The backup was restored. Confirm physical stock numbers before creating another real cheque.
